title: Week 2 Advanced: Password & policy (Windows)
readme:
# Windows 10 — Fellowship Logistics README
Please read the entire README thoroughly before modifying anything on this computer.

## Unique Identifier
Due to local scoring, you do not need to enter a Unique Identifier at this time. If asked to do so, enter whatever you'd like.

## Forensics Questions
This image has Forensics Questions, and you will receive points for answering them correctly. Open the **Forensics…** panel in the PT Comp scoring agent to read and answer them. Please read every Forensics Question thoroughly BEFORE modifying this computer, as a change you make may prevent you from answering a question correctly.

## Competition Scenario
This company's security policies require that all user accounts be password protected. Employees are required to choose secure passwords; however, this policy may not currently be enforced on this computer. The presence of any non-work-related media files and "hacking tools" on any company computer is strictly prohibited. This company does not use any centralized maintenance or polling tools to manage its IT equipment. This computer is for official business use only by authorized users. This is a critical computer in a production environment. Please do NOT attempt to upgrade the operating system on this machine.

## Windows 10
It is company policy to use only Windows 10 on this computer. It is also company policy to use only the latest, official, stable packages available for required software and services on this computer. Management has decided that the default web browser for all users on this computer should be the latest stable version of Google Chrome.

Welcome to the Fellowship Logistics workstation. This week's emphasis is PASSWORD & POLICY, but a full security review found problems across accounts, groups, password policy, the local security policy registry, services, and installed software. Harden the machine without removing what the company needs: enforce a strong password and account-lockout policy, remove any account that is not authorized, and strip administrative rights from any ordinary user who should not have them (boromir is an ordinary user and not an administrator; merry and pippin hold no special group memberships). Prohibited tools must be uninstalled, but legitimate applications must be left installed.

## Critical Services
- WinRM (remote management)
- SMB (the CompanyData file share)

Both services are currently stopped. Restore and secure them: the service account svc_winrm must be a least-privileged account (not an administrator), and the CompanyData share must be served but not open to Everyone.

## Authorized Administrators and Users
**Authorized Administrators:**
- The built-in Administrator account (the account you log in with).
**Authorized Users:**
- frodo
- sam
- aragorn
- gandalf
- boromir (ordinary user — not an administrator)
- merry
- pippin
- svc_winrm (service account — least-privileged, never an administrator)

## Competition Guidelines
- In order to provide a better practice experience, you are NOT required to change the password of the primary user account you log in with.
- Authorized administrator passwords were correct the last time a password audit was performed, but are not guaranteed to be currently accurate.
- Removing a legitimate installed application is a penalty.
- You can view your current scoring report at any time in the PT Comp scoring agent window.
- This is a Weekly Sprint practice scenario and is not an official CyberPatriot image.

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
function New-Pw { (-join ((48..57)+(65..90)+(97..122) | Get-Random -Count 12 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })) + 'Aa1!' }
function Ensure-Key($p) { if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { New-Item -Path $p -Force | Out-Null } }
# authorized users (kept) + unauthorized (to remove)
foreach ($u in 'frodo','sam','aragorn','gandalf','boromir','merry','pippin','sauron','saruman','gollum') {
    if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        New-LocalUser -Name $u -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString (New-Pw) -AsPlainText -Force) -PasswordNeverExpires | Out-Null
    }
    Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-545' -Member $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'boromir' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # wrongly admin
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-573' -Member 'merry'   -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # Event Log Readers
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'pippin'  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # Remote Management Users
# weak password policy (THEME)

$inf = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ptcomp_secpol.inf'
$sdb = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ptcomp_secpol.sdb'
Remove-Item $sdb -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
@"
[Unit]
Unicode=yes
[Version]
signature="`$CHICAGO`$"
Revision=1
[System Access]
MinimumPasswordLength = 0
PasswordComplexity = 0
ClearTextPassword = 1
MaximumPasswordAge = -1
MinimumPasswordAge = 0
LockoutBadCount = 0
"@ | Set-Content -Path $inf -Encoding Unicode
secedit /configure /db $sdb /cfg $inf /areas SECURITYPOLICY | Out-Null

# local policy registry (weak)
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'DisableCAD' -Type DWord -Value 1
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name 'ShutdownWithoutLogon' -Type DWord -Value 1
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FipsAlgorithmPolicy'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FipsAlgorithmPolicy' -Name 'Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers' -Name 'DisableWebPnPDownload' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\EventLog\ProtectedEventLogging'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\EventLog\ProtectedEventLogging' -Name 'EnableProtectedEventLogging' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'EnableSmartScreen' -Type DWord -Value 0
Ensure-Key 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender'
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender' -Name 'DisableAntiSpyware' -Type DWord -Value 1
# service hardening target: Print Spooler left enabled
Set-Service -Name Spooler -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# firewall off
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Private,Public -Enabled False
# persistence: an "orc generator" scheduled task (inert)
schtasks /Create /TN 'OrcGen' /TR 'cmd /c exit' /SC MINUTE /MO 30 /F | Out-Null
# installed software is real: files on disk, a Programs-and-Features entry, and a working uninstaller
function Install-App($Folder, $Exe, $DisplayName, $Version, $Publisher, $SizeKB, $Files) {
    $dir = Join-Path 'C:\Program Files' $Folder
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
    $exePath = Join-Path $dir $Exe
    $nm = ($DisplayName -replace '[^\w .()+-]','')
    $src = "using System;using System.Windows.Forms;static class P{[STAThread] static void Main(){MessageBox.Show(`"$nm is not authorized on this workstation.\nPlease uninstall it from Settings > Apps.`",`"$nm`",MessageBoxButtons.OK,MessageBoxIcon.Warning);}}"
    try { Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -OutputType WindowsApplication -OutputAssembly $exePath -ReferencedAssemblies 'System.Windows.Forms','System.Drawing' -ErrorAction Stop }
    catch { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($exePath, [byte[]]::new(262144)) }
    foreach ($f in $Files) {
        $fp = Join-Path $dir $f
        if ($f -match '\.(txt|log|cfg|ini|md)$') {
            Set-Content -Path $fp -Value ("$DisplayName $Version`r`n(c) $Publisher. All rights reserved.") -Encoding ASCII
        } else {
            $bz = Get-Random -Minimum 20480 -Maximum 262144
            $bb = [byte[]]::new($bz); (New-Object System.Random).NextBytes($bb); [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($fp, $bb)
        }
    }
    $key = Join-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall' $Folder
    $rm  = "Remove-Item '" + $key + "' -Recurse -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item '" + $dir + "' -Recurse -Force -EA SilentlyContinue"
    $uninst = 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "' + $rm + '"'
    Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $dir 'uninstall.cmd') -Value ('@echo off' + "`r`n" + $uninst) -Encoding ASCII
    Ensure-Key $key
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'DisplayName'          -Value $DisplayName -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'DisplayVersion'       -Value $Version     -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'Publisher'            -Value $Publisher   -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'InstallLocation'      -Value $dir         -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'DisplayIcon'          -Value (Join-Path $dir $Exe) -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'UninstallString'      -Value $uninst      -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'QuietUninstallString' -Value $uninst      -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'EstimatedSize'        -Value $SizeKB      -PropertyType DWord  -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'NoModify'             -Value 1            -PropertyType DWord  -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'NoRepair'             -Value 1            -PropertyType DWord  -Force | Out-Null
    New-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'InstallDate'          -Value (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd') -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
}
function Ensure-Choco {
    if (Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { return }
    $old = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072
        Invoke-Expression ((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1')) *> $null
    } catch { }
    $ErrorActionPreference = $old
    $env:Path = "$env:Path;C:\ProgramData\chocolatey\bin"
}
# install the REAL application via Chocolatey when possible; fall back to the decoy so scoring always holds
function Install-Real($Pkg, $Folder, $Exe, $DisplayName, $Version, $Publisher, $SizeKB, $Files) {
    Ensure-Choco
    if (Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        $old = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        try { choco install $Pkg -y --no-progress --ignore-dependencies --execution-timeout=360 *> $null } catch { }
        $ErrorActionPreference = $old
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path 'C:\Program Files' $Folder))) {
        Install-App $Folder $Exe $DisplayName $Version $Publisher $SizeKB $Files
    }
}
$script:PtDone = 0; $script:PtTotal = 5
function PtStep($label) { $script:PtDone++; Write-Output ("@@PTP@@ {0} {1} {2}" -f $script:PtDone, $script:PtTotal, $label) }
Write-Output "@@PTP@@ 0 5 Preparing"

PtStep 'Installing TeamViewer'; Install-App 'TeamViewer' 'TeamViewer.exe' 'TeamViewer'          '15.49.3'  'TeamViewer Germany GmbH'           120000 @('TeamViewer_Service.exe','tv_x64.dll','license.txt')
# prohibited files
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Videos' -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Music'  -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Documents' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Videos\gandalf_dance.mp4' -Value 'x' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Music\one_ring.mp3' -Value 'x' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Documents\creditcards.txt' -Value '4111111111111111' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\Documents\passwords.txt' -Value 'admin:Mellon123' -Encoding ASCII
# legitimate apps (installed for real; removing either is a penalty)
PtStep 'Installing 7-Zip'; Install-Real '7zip' '7-Zip'     '7zFM.exe'       '7-Zip 23.01 (x64)'        '23.01'  'Igor Pavlov'      5600  @('7z.exe','7z.dll','7-zip.chm','License.txt')
PtStep 'Installing Notepad++'; Install-Real 'notepadplusplus' 'Notepad++' 'notepad++.exe'  'Notepad++ (64-bit x64)'   '8.6.2'  'Notepad++ Team'   16000 @('SciLexer.dll','readme.txt','change.log')
# forensics: a downloaded file carrying its Zone.Identifier (mark-of-the-web) + a base64 note
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\meme.png' -Value 'PNGDATA' -Encoding ASCII
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\meme.png' -Stream 'Zone.Identifier' -Value "[ZoneTransfer]`r`nZoneId=3`r`nHostUrl=http://mordor-downloads.example/meme.png`r`nReferrerUrl=http://mordor-downloads.example/"
Set-Content -Path 'C:\Users\Public\forensics\note.b64' -Value 'cHJlY2lvdXM=' -Encoding ASCII

# --- WinRM remote management: stopped, with an over-privileged service account + a rogue remote user
function New-Pw2 { (-join ((48..57)+(65..90)+(97..122) | Get-Random -Count 10 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })) + 'Aa1!' }
foreach ($u in 'svc_winrm','mordoragent') {
    if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        New-LocalUser -Name $u -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString (New-Pw2) -AsPlainText -Force) -PasswordNeverExpires | Out-Null
    }
    Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-545' -Member $u -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-544' -Member 'svc_winrm'   -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # wrongly admin
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'svc_winrm'   -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Add-LocalGroupMember -SID 'S-1-5-32-580' -Member 'mordoragent' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue   # rogue remote user
Stop-Service -Name WinRM -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service  -Name WinRM -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# --- CompanyData share: created WHILE the Server service runs (a prior practice may have left it
#     stopped, and New-SmbShare needs it running — System Error 2114), then stopped + open to Everyone
Set-Service  -Name LanmanServer -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name LanmanServer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\CompanyData' -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content -Path 'C:\CompanyData\sentinel.txt' -Value 'PT-SMB-OK-7B2E' -Encoding ASCII
if (-not (Get-SmbShare -Name 'CompanyData' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    New-SmbShare -Name 'CompanyData' -Path 'C:\CompanyData' -FullAccess 'Everyone' | Out-Null
} else {
    Grant-SmbShareAccess -Name 'CompanyData' -AccountName 'Everyone' -AccessRight Full -Force | Out-Null
}
Stop-Service -Name LanmanServer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service  -Name LanmanServer -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
